title: Putnami specs baseline v1 and v2
$comment: The committed enforce floor of the executable-spec gate. Version 2 is one enforced project's file, in that project's directory: the directory names the project, the file's presence states enforce, and the file lists the executable requirements the project covers. Version 1 is the older single workspace-root file listing every enforced project; readers accept it only at the root, and `putnami specs baseline --update` moves it to version 2 files. Shrink-only: losing a listed requirement, or a project leaving enforce, without editing its file in the same change fails validate-workspace. Growth never requires an edit.

protocolVersion.$comment: Readers require the exact JSON integer token 2; 2.0 and 2e0 are invalid.
Readers require the exact JSON integer token 1; 1.0 and 1e0 are invalid.

mode.$comment: The baseline records the enforced floor; a report or off project has nothing to protect.
